item.title: Weaponized SaaS Supply Chains: Inside the Optimizely Malware Exploitation
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
A silent compromise within Optimizely’s trusted CDN delivered advanced iOS exploit kits and card skimmers across 178 major enterprise sites, including Zoom, Salesforce, and the BBC. Strategic intelligence analyst Alexander Sterling unpacks this digital supply chain assault.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The attack payload featured advanced iOS exploit kits (Coruna and DarkSword) linked to Russian state-aligned threat actors alongside commercial financial skimming engines. [SPLIT] ⚡ High-value enterprise and media portals—including Zoom, Salesforce, CNN, and the BBC—served as unintended distribution vectors for high-tier mobile zero-day and N-day exploits. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/weaponized-saas-supply-chains-inside-the-optimizely-malware-exploitation-005870.html

item.title: Astra Microwave Locks March 2027 Deadline for First Uttam Radars
item.dc:creator: Amarjeet Singh
item.description:
Astra Microwave has locked in a March 2027 deadline to deliver its first two indigenous Uttam AESA radars for the Tejas Mk1A, injecting critical momentum into India's indigenous combat aviation roadmap.
[SPLIT] ⚡ The ₹1,844 crore production order forms the bedrock of Astra's current consolidated order book, which stands at ₹4,708 crore. [SPLIT] ⚡ The indigenous AESA radar milestone directly addresses long-standing bottlenecks in the Tejas Mk1A manufacturing pipeline. [SPLIT] 🔗 Read full report → https://neodymium.world/articles/astra-microwave-locks-march-2027-deadline-for-first-uttam-radars-953119.html
